create.name: Michelle Masters
create.bio:
Michelle Masters is a coach and trainer in neuro-linguistic programming (NLP) who has worked in personal change since the mid-1990s. After early years in theatre, set painting and environmental education, she found NLP Marin in 1994, completed its practitioner levels and went on to train students there for close to twenty-five years. Her present work blends NLP techniques with family constellation work and what she calls quantum transformation methods, and she is often described as a coach to other coaches.

Her best-known programme is Money Magic, now offered as The Money Reset, which looks at the inherited beliefs and family patterns that shape how people earn, spend and receive, and invites them to rework those patterns gently rather than by force of will. She runs it as a two-day live workshop in Marin County and as a ten-week online course, alongside guided self-study processes on money, relationships and wellbeing and a free masterclass on lifting an 'invisible ceiling' on income. Her book Wired for Money grew out of the workshop. She trades as Wired for Magic, teaches internationally, and appeared as one of the coaches in the docuseries The Year of Transformation.

books.title: Wired for Money: Change the Patterns That Block You from Thriving
books.author: Michelle Masters
books.description: Based on her Money Magic workshop, the book uses stories and short exercises to help readers notice and loosen the inherited beliefs that shape their relationship with money.

courses.title: The Money Reset Live: 2-Day In-Person Event
courses.description: A two-day interactive workshop in Novato, California, combining NLP exercises, family constellation work and energy-based processes to look at and shift patterns around money.

courses.title: The Online Money Reset
courses.description: A ten-week guided online version of the Money Reset, with live group calls at two times of day, recordings kept for six months and self-paced material in a members' portal.

courses.title: The 3 Chairs Process: Money
courses.description: A self-guided process with worksheets and audio, the exercise that first inspired her money work, for exploring and revising limiting beliefs about money at home.

free_resources.title: How to Break Through Your Invisible Money Ceiling
free_resources.description: A free online masterclass on why income often seems to settle back to the same level, and how to raise what you feel able to receive.

free_resources.title: Wired for Money: First Three Chapters
free_resources.description: The opening three chapters of her book, free to download after giving an email address.
